annotations.title: Sanctions name screen — OFAC SDN + Consolidated (US)

description: Sanctions name screen — OFAC SDN + Consolidated (US). Screen a person or company name against the U.S. Treasury OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Consolidated lists (~40k names + aliases; every result carries as_of and checked_at so you can see how current the list is). Deterministic normalized-name and token matching with a CLEAR / REVIEW / HIT verdict — the check a payments, marketplace or KYC agent runs on every new counterparty. $0.02 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.
